headline: Session in the bank — easy spin held exactly where it needed to
summary: Solid execution: 30min prescribed, 37m52s logged, HR averaged 110 (well inside the 115-130 target band, max only 135), RPE 2/10, feel 3. Load landed at 19 vs the 15 estimate — trivial overage, nothing to read into. This was exactly what a pre-threshold top-up should look like: no fatigue cost banked. HRV this morning was 67, the best reading of the block, RHR 47, sleep 7h04 — you're walking into tomorrow's 3x8min threshold session (the Tue gate) with a genuinely clean readiness picture, not just a rested one.
flags: Cadence wasn't logged on this trainer file (no cadence stream), so can't confirm the 85-95rpm target was hit — worth glancing at the Garmin screen next time if that matters to you.
3-day HRV mean (67, 55, 52 = ~58) is comfortably above the 48 threshold gate and no single reading is near the 40 floor — Tuesday's threshold session is a clean go on current data.
